signals.message: DRIVER CONSTRAINT from feat/backend-foundation (task id:4 spike): Drizzle's neon-http driver has NO db.transaction() support — it throws 'No transactions support in neon-http driver'. db.batch([...]) IS supported (Neon wraps a batch in one transaction) but batched statements cannot read each other's results. This directly affects feat/economy-engine task id:22 (ADR-3 atomic achievement-award + ledger write): do NOT implement as two awaited queries. Use a single-statement data-modifying CTE (INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING, feeding the ledger INSERT) — verified working against the live DB, and an empty result set doubles as the 'already awarded' idempotency signal. May require lib/ledger.ts to expose a CTE/batch-participating form alongside its standalone insert. Full pattern + measurements in tech-design.md 'Spike result: Neon pooling under Fluid Compute'. Pooling itself is a NON-issue: 175 concurrent queries used <=7 of 112 connections. Secondary note for feat/admin-dashboard: each neon-http query is its own HTTPS round trip, so batch/join in SQL rather than per-row query loops (100 concurrent queries showed ~13x per-query latency degradation).

PARTITION 2 COMPLETE — lib/ layer is now stable and frozen for consumers. Signatures for feat/api-and-bot-contract and feat/admin-dashboard to build against: evaluateScoreSubmission({userId, gameId, score, isDailySubmission}) -> AwardResult[]; submitDailyScore({userId, gameId, score, submittedVia, gameDate?}) -> AwardResult[]; computeDailyLeaderboard(gameId, gameDate?) -> DailyLeaderboardResult; settleDailyTopScore(gameId, gameDate?) -> AwardResult|null; spendTokens(userId, gameId) -> {newBalance, cost, reason} (throws InsufficientBalanceError with .details {required, balance} -> map to 402, and UnknownGameError); awardDailyLoginBonus(userId) -> {awarded}; completeContentItem(userId, contentItemId, answerText, now?) -> {status:'awarded', award}|{status:'already_completed_today'} (throws UnknownContentItemError/InactiveContentItemError); listContentForUser(userId) -> items with completedToday. TWO NOTES: (1) settleDailyTopScore is one-shot per game/day by constraint — call it only after the day closes, since whoever leads at first successful call keeps the award. (2) Interval-gap achievement awards intentionally write NO achievement_awards row (that table's unique key means once-ever, wrong for repeatable gap awards); they are guarded by a watermark compare-and-set. This diverges from one approach.md acceptance criterion as literally written — flagged inline for Builder confirmation. Also: two new migrations (0001, 0002) — run npm run db:migrate before working.

PARTITION 3 COMPLETE — API layer stable for feat/admin-dashboard and feat/site-integration. THREE THINGS PARTITION 4 MUST KNOW: (1) MIGRATION 0003 is new — run npm run db:migrate. It adds unique bounties(game_id, game_date); computeDailyLeaderboard() always assumed one row per game/day but nothing enforced it. (2) isValidBotApiKey MOVED from lib/auth.ts to lib/bot-key.ts — lib/auth.ts now exports only Auth.js machinery (handlers, auth, signIn, signOut). Import the key check from lib/bot-key.ts. Note next-auth CANNOT be imported under vitest's node env at all (fails to resolve next/server), so any admin page test must vi.mock('@/lib/auth') wholesale rather than spreading importOriginal — see app/api/__tests__/routes.test.ts for the working pattern. (3) POST /api/bot/log now EXISTS and is the writer for bot_log_events — Partition 4 task id:68 (Bot Log page) has real data to read; it is a read-only feed, do not add write UI. ALSO REUSABLE BY PARTITION 4: lib/api-auth.ts exports requireSession() -> {userId, isAdmin} (throws 401) and the handle() error boundary (ZodError->400, HttpError->its status, else logged opaque 500); the /admin guard (id:60) should check isAdmin off that same session shape, which lib/auth.ts's session callback already populates from users.isAdmin. lib/cors.ts is browser-origin allow-listing only and is irrelevant to same-origin admin pages. PERFORMANCE REMINDER STILL LIVE: each neon-http query is its own HTTPS round trip, so batch/join in SQL on the Users list and Analytics pages rather than looping per row.

PARTITION 4 COMPLETE — /admin dashboard done. FOR feat/site-integration (Partition 5): the API contract you consume is unchanged and documented in arcade-backend/docs/discord-bot-api.md (the session-only routes GET /api/balance, POST /api/spend, GET /api/content, POST /api/content/complete are the ones the arcade site calls). CORS: lib/cors.ts allow-lists https://arcade.cartercripe.com plus dev localhost:5173 by default; set CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS and CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGIN_SUFFIXES in the Vercel project for the real production/preview origins. Credentials are sent, so the site must fetch with credentials:'include'. NEW DEV DEPS in arcade-backend: @vitejs/plugin-react (PINNED v4 — v6 needs Vite 8, vitest 2.1.9 ships Vite 5), @testing-library/react, @testing-library/jest-dom, jsdom; vitest.config.ts now has a react() plugin and a second setup file lib/test-setup.ts, and component tests opt into jsdom per-file with an @vitest-environment docblock. NEW SHARED MODULES: lib/admin.ts (aggregate reads), lib/admin-guard.ts (getAdminSession). KNOWN COUPLING worth not breaking: Analytics counts plays by matching transactions.reason against a reconstructed '{Tier}: {Display Name}' string, because transactions has no game_id — if site-integration changes the spend reason copy, that count silently goes to zero.
